description: Learn about Debre Mihret Kidus Gebriel Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church in Christchurch

history.title: About Debre Mihret Kidus Gebriel
history.p1: Debre Mihret Kidus Gebriel Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church was established to serve the growing Ethiopian community in Christchurch, New Zealand. Our church is named after the Archangel Gabriel, one of the most revered angels in the Ethiopian Orthodox tradition.
history.p2: We are part of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, one of the oldest Christian churches in the world, with roots going back to the 4th century. The word 'Tewahedo' means 'unified' — reflecting our belief in the unified nature of Christ.

faith.title: The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Tradition
faith.p1: Our church is established based on the teachings and doctrines of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, a member of the Oriental Orthodox churches. We strive to fulfil the spiritual needs of our members by providing spiritual services in a manner consistent with the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church's faith, values, and tradition.
faith.p2: We teach the faithful about the seven sacraments of the church: Baptism, Confirmation (Myron), Penance (Confession), Holy Communion (the Eucharist), Unction of the Sick, Holy Matrimony, and Holy Orders.
faith.p3: Our church also teaches the five pillars of mystery — the Holy Trinity, the Incarnation, Baptism, the Eucharist, and the Resurrection of the Dead — along with the Creed (prayer of faith). Furthermore, the faithful are called to keep the Ten Commandments and follow the teachings of our Lord Jesus Christ.
faith.p4: We emphasise the importance of teaching and understanding the Holy Scripture as the basis of knowing God and the experience of a meaningful and fruitful Christian life. Please come and join us in this spiritual journey.
